v1Limitations: Only five V1 physical font faces are bundled. Optional font-library choices, imported-font reordering, TTS, auto page-turn, and source switching are not claimed.
PNG icon outputs preserve source colors and aspect at a 24pt canvas. Device visual calibration remains open.
Chapter heading is system-scaled per frozen TYPE_READER_CHAPTER_TITLE; reader body uses saved appearance size. Layout must scale the explicit heading line box once.

Frozen Host static UI fonts are reused exactly except registration names. Their existing source provenance records failed static-versus-variable outline equivalence; no new upstream-equivalence or device-font-parity claim is made.
V1 header search is explicitly local bookshelf text filtering. Global source search and source/content-type chips are outside scope; no fake remote results are rendered.
V1 bookshelf menu contains real local import and persisted layout choices only; unavailable download/update/batch-book actions are omitted.
Shelf static endpoints use the frozen metrics. The 1000ms layered Cover/List choreography and the populated tablet rail are not implemented or claimed.
Bottom navigation uses the frozen two-tab 196x68 endpoint; platform safe-area placement and Dynamic Type line-box calibration still require rendered evidence.
Frozen paper texture and lighting layers are implemented by ReaderPaperBackground; cross-platform raster interpolation and rendered device visual parity remain unverified.

Brightness has no automatic-mode API or control on iOS. Simulator brightness-property checks can verify local lifecycle semantics only; physical display dimming and device acceptance remain unverified.

appIcon.transformation: sharp/libvips resize frozen opaque 1254x1254 PNG to 1024x1024; no authored artwork, alpha, or background changes.

lighting.renderer: sharp/libvips from unchanged registered SVG; normal source-over alpha blending; Phone390x844 and Tablet760x960 raster endpoints at 1x/2x/3x; stretched to actual canvas as in Host ImageFit.Fill

paperBackground.scopeBoundary: ReaderPaperFxLayer is absent from frozen Host33f7. No later native shader, random noise, new paper effect, or device-equivalence claim is included.

brightness.adaptation: Existing frozen HLG formulas translated without algorithm changes. Thin UIKit screen access is resolved from the actual hosting window scene. Synchronous native writes need no copied asynchronous recovery queue. Cancel observes the last applied value; reader exit/scene deactivation restore the original baseline; activation reads a new baseline.
brightness.validationBoundary: No brightness build/test or device execution performed by this resource task. Local value/lifecycle verification cannot establish physical display response, calibration, or automatic brightness behavior. Automatic brightness is not exposed.
